title: Make your point land
context: Your project team asks which of two vendors to choose: a cheaper new one, or the familiar, pricier one.
target_behavior: State your recommendation first, give two relevant reasons, then invite a response.
why_it_matters: Attention drops fast in meetings. Leading with the recommendation means people hear it even if they tune out halfway.

example.text: I'd go with the Lisbon vendor. They're 20% cheaper, and they've already passed our security review. What would you want covered before we sign?
example.explanation: Recommendation in the first sentence, two reasons that matter to the decision, then an invitation to respond.

steps: Read the target and listen to the example.
Jordan starts the conversation — answer with the target in mind.
Jordan will respond once, maybe with an objection. Adapt.
Get feedback on where the target showed up. Try again if you like.

feedback.headline: Good start — now bring the recommendation forward.

where.quote: So I think maybe we should, um, look at both options first.

what_worked: You gave a concrete reason the listener cares about.
feedback.one_change: Name the second reason before you invite a response.

feedback.headline: Your recommendation came early — that's the core of this skill.

where.quote: I'd go with the second vendor.

what_worked: You gave a concrete reason the listener cares about.
feedback.one_change: Name the second reason before you invite a response.

comparison.summary: This time your first answer was 16 words (before: 12). You stated your recommendation earlier and kept both reasons.
changes: Recommendation moved into the first sentence
Ended with a question that invites a response
comparison.note: A shorter answer isn't automatically a better one — we compared both attempts against the same target.

reflections.text: I led with my recommendation in standup and people responded faster.
reflections.coach_reply: That's great — trying it in a real conversation is the hardest part. Next time, aim for just the first part of the target: state your recommendation first.
